preGenerationArtReadout.proportions: Large expressive heads, compact approximately 2.5-head bodies, visible feet and layered compact robes. Approved Cai Bang body height approximately 44 logical pixels.
preGenerationArtReadout.linework: Stepped dark selective outlines and clustered highlights/shadows, dark hair mass, clear face and weapon silhouettes.
preGenerationArtReadout.palette: Vo Dang charcoal/ivory with pale energy; Cai Bang red/cream/brown. Thien Son brief changes to ivory/white, sky blue and jade with blue-gray shadows.
preGenerationArtReadout.perspective: Stable orthographic elevated three-quarter overworld view, top of hair/shoulders plus face/body visible.
preGenerationArtReadout.attackPoseDirection: References show windup, extended contact and follow-through silhouettes. Not authored or verified in this concept phase.

design.appearance: Young male aristocratic martial artist, long dark topknot hair, jade/silver hair fastener, ivory/pale-blue ribbons, layered ivory silk robes, pale-blue inner collar, jade sash/trim, restrained silver clasps and wind-scroll embroidery, dark blue-gray shoes.
design.signatureWeapon: Open ivory folding combat fan with dark ribs, jade edging and simple wind-scroll motifs, held in anatomical right hand away from face.
design.secondaryWeapon: Curved dao in a jade-gray scabbard at anatomical left hip; hilt visible. Blade geometry must be locked when attack art is authored.
design.windLanguage: Directional pale jade air wisps, fluttering hair/ribbons, sleeves and split robe hems; no visible ice, frost, icicles or snowflakes.

outputs.background: Opaque muted dark blue-green concept presentation background

existingProductionConventionsInspected.atlas: Aseprite json-hash PNG/JSON with frameTags and feet pivot slice
existingProductionConventionsInspected.timing: Idle 2 x 350ms; walk 4 x 120ms; basic attack 4 x 75ms, except Bong left/right sweeps 6 x 50ms. These are existing conventions, not produced Thien Son animations.
existingProductionConventionsInspected.rendering: Nearest filtering; camera zoom 1; normal desktop integer display scale 2.
existingProductionConventionsInspected.futureLocations: Editable animation sources under assets/source/characters/; transparent PNG/JSON exports under assets/exports/characters/; concept directory excluded from runtime.

validation.conceptContrast: Ivory/white garment mass outlined with dark blue-gray shadows against dark blue-green backdrop.
validation.phaserVerification: Not run: concept-only phase, awaiting explicit approval.
validation.typecheckTestsBrowserSmoke: Not run: no code or runtime assets changed. PNG integrity and existing approved baseline hashes checked separately.

approvalConcerns: Concept enlargement is not a native gameplay frame or proof of normal-zoom detail, scale or fan readability.
Fine embroidery, silver details, fan ribs, scabbard curve and asymmetric weapon placement need a consistent pixel-scale model lock after approval.
Wind movement, four-direction continuity, pivots, animation timing and transitions require Phase 2/3 authored frames and live Phaser checks.
stopCondition: Concept and requested runtime art approved. Character art workflow complete; no other schools, environments or combat abilities authorized.
